author: Robin_DD_J
body:
So in the map Scorpio, as you can see under me right now VVVV

So it kinda annoys me how the Cyan team and Blue team "almost" look the same, I would like to suggest: Make cyans armor more like cyan armor and not blue armor! Or remove the cyan team and replace it with maybe a purple, red, black, white team. I know this confuses many players and I think it would be good to, yeah.. Remove or make the armor better!


Thanks for reading!
